steps.note: Sugar and a stabiliser are added to the yoghurt.

steps.name: freeze
steps.note: Air is whipped into it in an ice-cream freezer until it is 30–60 % bigger, then it is optionally hardened.

links.name: US patent 10,117,445 B2 (Google Patents), frozen yogurt process

sources.text: One patented process, in which the yoghurt mix is cultured, cooled and frozen; other makers blend finished yoghurt into the mix instead.
